Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE X OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY BOARD ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE X OF 2001
An Ordinance to
provide for the establishment of the Balochistan Information Technology Board
in the Province of Balochistan
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th May, 2001]
No. Legis. 1-130/Law/2001,
dated 30-5-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 18th May, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Information
Technology Board Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Establishment

ORDINANCE X OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY BOARD ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE X OF 2001
An Ordinance to
provide for the establishment of the Balochistan Information Technology Board
in the Province of Balochistan
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th May, 2001]
No. Legis. 1-130/Law/2001,
dated 30-5-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 18th May, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Establishment.---(1)
The Government may establish a Board to be called the Balochistan Information
Technology Board.
(2) The Board shall be a body
corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal with powers to acquire,
hold and dispose of property and by the said name sue and be sued.

Constitution of the Board

ORDINANCE X OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY BOARD ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE X OF 2001
An Ordinance to
provide for the establishment of the Balochistan Information Technology Board
in the Province of Balochistan
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th May, 2001]
No. Legis. 1-130/Law/2001,
dated 30-5-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 18th May, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
3. Constitution of the
Board.---(1) The Board shall consist of such number of members as may be
appointed by the Government.
(2) The Government shall appoint
one member as President of the Board.
(3) No act, proceedings or
decision of the Board shall be invalid by reason of any vacancy or defect in
the constitution of the Board.

Functions and powers of the Board

ORDINANCE X OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY BOARD ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE X OF 2001
An Ordinance to

[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th May, 2001]
No. Legis. 1-130/Law/2001,
dated 30-5-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 18th May, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
4. Functions and powers of the
Board.--The Board shall take all such measures as it deems necessary for
the administration of its affairs and for promotion, development and use of
information technology.

Chairman

ORDINANCE X OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY BOARD ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE X OF 2001
An Ordinance to
provide for the establishment of the Balochistan Information Technology Board

No. Legis. 1-130/Law/2001,
dated 30-5-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 18th May, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
5. Chairman.--(1) The
Government shall appoint Chairman of the Board whose terms and conditions of
service shall be such as may be determined by the Government.
(2) The Chairman shall perform
such functions as may be assigned to him by the Board.

Delegation of powers

ORDINANCE X OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY BOARD ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE X OF 2001
An Ordinance to

No. Legis. 1-130/Law/2001,
dated 30-5-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 18th May, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
6. Delegation of powers.--(1)
The Board may delegate to any person any of its powers, duties and functions.
(2) The Chairman may delegate any
of his powers including delegated powers to any officer of the Board.

Funds of the Board

ORDINANCE X OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY BOARD ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE X OF 2001
An Ordinance to

[Gazette of

No. Legis. 1-130/Law/2001,
dated 30-5-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 18th May, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
7. Funds of the Board.--(1)
There shall be a fund known as Information Technology Board Fund which may vest
in the Board and to which shall be credited all moneys received by the Board.
(2) The fund shall be kept in
such custody and shall be utilized and regulated in such manner as may be
prescribed by rules.
(3) The Government shall provide
funds to Information Technology Board for its Secretariat and other necessary
and incidental expenses.

Budget, audit and accounts

Balochistan on 18th May, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
8. Budget, audit and
accounts.---(1) The budget of the Board shall be approved and its accounts
shall be maintained and audited in such manner as may be prescribed by rules.

9. Employees of the Board.---The
Board may employ such officers, advisors, consultant and employees in its
services as may be necessary for the efficient performance of its functions in
such manner and on such terms and conditions as may be prescribed by the Board.

any difficulty arises in giving effect to any provision of this Ordinance, the
Government may make such order as may be necessary for removing the difficulty.
